The reference emits nothing and returns False when the output is not a terminal. The candidate has no terminal guard and no success indication. On a legacy-Windows console whose stdout is redirected, the candidate can still reach LegacyWindowsTerm.set_title (SetConsoleTitle) via the _check_buffer legacy path, which the reference guards against. The candidate also lacks tests for the Console method and the Windows dispatch.
